s.zh: 夺心魔首领的残脑里还留着一段记忆：一只眼魔的巢穴
s.en: The mind flayer leader's remaining brain still holds a memory: a beholder's lair

s.zh: 无尽墓穴（半巫妖的坟墓）
显露在世界地图上（离殖民地 6～15 格），
s.en: is revealed on the world map (6-15 cells from the colony), and vanishes in

s.zh: 眼魔每 3 秒从眼柄射出 1～2 道射线（魅惑、麻痹、恐惧、减速、衰弱、石化、解离、死亡、睡眠、念动，全部可以豁免）；打掉一根眼柄就少一种射线。它正面 60° 锥形 20 格内不能施法、护盾腰带失效——从侧面和背后打。
s.en: The beholder fires 1-2 rays from its eyestalks every 3 seconds (charm, paralysis, fear, slow, enfeeble, petrification, disintegration, death, sleep, telekinesis, all can be saved against); destroying an eyestalk removes a ray type. Within its 60° frontal cone up to 20 cells, no spells can be cast and shield belts fail; attack from the sides and back.

s.zh: 半巫妖每 60 秒发出一次吞魂之嚎：20 格内所有活人做体质豁免（难度 21，基础成功率 10%，属性调整值和熟练加值每点 +5%），失败倒地、灵魂撕裂，30 秒内不救治就死。巫妖和死灵造物免疫。它只有一颗头骨，银器伤害 ×2。
s.en: The demilich lets out a soul-devouring howl every 60 seconds: every living person within 20 cells makes a Constitution save (difficulty 21, base success 10%, +5% per point of ability modifier and proficiency bonus); on failure they go down with a torn soul and die if not treated within 30 seconds. Liches and necromantic constructs are immune. It's only a skull; silver weapons deal ×2 damage.

s.zh: [DND边缘大陆] 传奇怪行为出错：
吞了下去！打它 60 点伤害就能让它吐出来。
s.en: down! Deal 60 damage to it to make it spit them out.

s.zh: 传奇怪没有开启（设置里的“传奇怪”）
s.en: Legendary monsters aren't enabled ("legendary monsters" in settings)

s.zh: 吸收了灵魂宝石里的灵魂：命匣 +
s.en: absorbed the soul in the soul gem: phylactery +

s.zh: 只有有命匣的巫妖能用
s.en: Only liches with a phylactery can use this

s.zh: 一条贝希尔循着龙的气味找到了这里。它是真龙的死敌——对龙的伤害 ×1.5，不怕龙的威仪——但它同样饿了。\n\n它会喷出一道闪电，还会把离它太近的人一口吞下（打它 60 点伤害，它就会吐出来）。
s.en: A behir followed the scent of dragons here. It's the mortal enemy of true dragons (×1.5 damage against dragons, unafraid of draconic presence), but it's hungry too.\n\nIt breathes a bolt of lightning and swallows whole anyone who gets too close (deal 60 damage to it and it spits them out).

s.zh: 贝希尔、眼魔、死亡骑士、半巫妖。都有传奇抗性和传奇动作，强度跟着上面的“真龙强度”。关闭后下面的登场都不出现。
s.en: Behirs, beholders, death knights, demiliches. All have legendary resistance and legendary actions, with strength following "true dragon strength" above. When off, none of the appearances below happen.

s.zh: 有人杀过成年以上的真龙时，低概率来一条贝希尔。它也会出现在青年 / 成年龙巢附近，和龙打起来。
s.en: When someone has killed an adult or older true dragon, a behir occasionally comes. It also appears near young / adult dragon lairs and fights the dragons.

s.zh: 击杀幽暗殖巢的夺心魔首领后 20% 显露（或同盟商队卖情报）。
s.en: 20% chance to be revealed after killing the Underdark Hive's mind flayer leader (or alliance caravans sell the intel).

s.zh: 殖民地最高冒险者等级 ≥24 时，同盟商队会卖墓穴情报。
s.en: When the colony's highest adventurer level is ≥24, alliance caravans sell tomb intel.

s.zh: 塞伊远征军 ≥5000 点的袭击 10% 由死亡骑士带队；拉洛克古墓里 50% 多一名死亡骑士守卫。
s.en: 10% of Thayan expedition raids of ≥5000 points are led by a death knight; Larloch's ancient tomb has a 50% chance of an extra death knight guard.

s.zh: 1.140.0：塞伊远征军的袭击有一种「亡灵军团」编组（约 1/4）：红袍死灵法师带着噬尸鬼、尸妖、怨灵、吸血鬼。关闭后这一组里的亡灵换成普通远征军。
s.en: 1.140.0: Thayan expedition raids have an "undead legion" group (about 1/4): Red Wizard necromancers with ghouls, wights, wraiths and vampires. When off, the undead in this group are replaced with ordinary expedition troops.
